ComplianceRadar AI Monitor v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches automated, continuous monitoring of SEC, FDA, FINRA, and GDPR regulatory changes.
- Uses AI for real-time impact assessment and generates actionable compliance reports.
- Integrates directly with Slack for team notifications and Google Sheets for audit logging.
- Supports auto-generation of compliant policy updates, staff training materials, and audit evidence.
- Provides easy configuration via environment variables and YAML for targeted, multi-source monitoring.
